title: Epstein blackmail file on senior national security official

tellings.quote: because there's a very senior person in the national security apparatus who is was part of that who's being kept on a short leash because they have a a blackmail file on it.

plain: A very senior person in the US national security world was caught up with the financier Jeffrey Epstein, and is now kept on a short leash because a blackmail file exists on them. That's the claim of Steven Greer, a UFO activist, who presents it as something he was told and names no one. If true, it would mean someone high up in the government could be quietly controlled.
